_comment: T2 stale-alone. KG-00003 (target, 90d) is the only entry in the store about on-call ownership -- no fresher entry contradicts or updates it. 9 unrelated filler notes hold the store at 10 entries and never mention on-call ownership, so the model has nothing to triangulate against except the age presentation on the stamp itself. Dates are absolute and fixed against presentation.json's current_date (2026-07-31).
mission_line: Mission: You are Ops, the platform cell's assistant. Answer teammates' questions accurately using what you know.
task_question: Who owns the on-call rotation right now? Answer in 1-2 sentences.

entries.title: Deploy pipeline schedule
entries.content: The deploy pipeline runs nightly at 02:00 UTC from the release branch.

entries.title: Vendor invoice approval path
entries.content: Invoices under 500 go straight to accounting; anything larger needs the cell lead's sign-off first, logged in the shared tracker.

entries.title: On-call rotation ownership
entries.content: The on-call rotation owner is Priya.

entries.title: Feature flag rollout convention
entries.content: New flags default to 1% internal-only, then 10/50/100 over a week; skip stages only with the cell lead's written go-ahead.

entries.title: Secrets rotation cadence
entries.content: Service credentials rotate every 90 days via the vault pipeline; a manual rotation is logged in the security channel same day.

entries.title: Standup cadence for the platform cell
entries.content: Standups moved to 09:30 UTC after the London hire; the Friday slot is written notes only, no call.

entries.title: Build cache flakiness on the arm runners
entries.content: The arm64 CI runners occasionally serve a stale build cache; a re-run with CACHE_BUST=1 clears it. Filed upstream, no fix yet.

entries.title: Docs style ruling
entries.content: Docs speak present truth -- no 'previously' framing, history lives in git. User-facing surfaces get one short sentence with no internals.

entries.title: Incident postmortem template location
entries.content: Postmortems live in the incidents repo under templates/postmortem.md; fill every section before the retro, even the N/A ones.

entries.title: Staging database refresh procedure
entries.content: Staging refreshes from the Sunday snapshot; never refresh mid-week because the analytics backfill reads staging directly.
